_comment: Attitude-gate config for GJC pre_tool_use hooks (write/edit/bash mutations).
Default enabled=false, so a global install is a NO-OP until you opt in here.
To use globally: copy this to ~/.gjc/agent/hooks/attitude-gate.json and set enabled=true.
Per project, put the agreed spec in <project>/.gjc/spec.md.
specExists     - .gjc/spec.md must exist & be non-empty (HARD; no adaptation)
specReferenced - the spec must be read this session before a mutation
intentReported - an 'INTENT: <goal>' / '의도: <목표>' line must precede a mutation
todoActive     - a todo_write list or goal(create/resume) must exist before a
mutation, so GJC compaction auto-continue keeps firing on
unfinished work (default false; opt in per machine)
failClosed: on internal hook error, true=block (safe), false=allow (never brick).
NOTE: intentReported/specReferenced must appear in a PRIOR assistant turn; if the
model emits them in the same turn as the mutation the first attempt may block and
the model retries. This is by design (it forces the behavior).
